name: first_mutation_artifact_lane_v1
description: Primitive first-mutation stage for low-complexity existing-project coding tasks. It receives an already-built context packet and emits only mutation receipts or an explicit blocker.

primitive_first_contract.special_case_policy: Eval fixtures, expected symbols, framework names, and benchmark levels must remain outside this primitive. This lane only constrains the first mutation action shape.
primitive_first_contract.monotonic_lower_level_regression_policy: This lane may be enabled for selected coding lanes only. It must not alter create-file fast path, validation, repair, checkpoint, memory, or final response semantics.

fields.context_receipts: bounded local context evidence already read by a context primitive

fields.blocked_reason: present when no safe mutation can be emitted from supplied context

rules: May not run validation or probes.
May not write checkpoint or memory artifacts.
May not produce final user-facing success.
Must prefer file_patch when exact observed text is available.
Must emit only file_write/file_patch mutation tool calls or an explicit no-mutation blocker.
